 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Prateek Jalan
 Order
% 25.02.2026 Crl.M.A. 5586/2026 (for impleadment)

1.  By order dated 03.11.2025, it was directed as follows:
"1.

This is a petition for quashing of FIR No. 238/2023, under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, registered at Police Station K N Katju Marg and all proceedings emanating therefrom.

entities.text: Police Station K N Katju Marg
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioners that both parties have come to an amicable settlement, however, learned APP appearing on behalf of State points out that father-in-law of respondent No. 2 is also one of the accused before the trial Court, but, he is not party to the present petition.

3. Let necessary steps be taken to implead father-in-law of respondent No. 2.
4. Re-notify on 10.04.2026."
2. This application has been filed seeking impleadment of Mr. Suraj Prakash Gupta, father-in-law of respondent No. 2.
3.
For the reasons stated, the application is allowed, and the amended memo of parties filed alongwith the application is taken on record.

The application stands disposed of.
Respondent No. 3 - Mr. Suraj Prakash Gupta, appears in person through video conference, and states that he wishes to make some submissions.
Although he is an accused in the case, he states that he does not wish for the case to be settled or for the FIR to be quashed.
To enable him to seek legal advice, if he so wishes, list on 10.04.2026.
